=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:272-277 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: REVIEW_EDITOR_ENGINE_FELL_BACK is only ever written as true to GITHUB_ENV and never reset to false across editor retry attempts or invocations (read at scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:338-345).
  WHY: A later Claude-written commit is still authored as codex-bot, which contradicts the PR's contract. Reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:318-327 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The claude-bot decision checks only the claude-implement*.unavailable markers, but scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh (lines 78-83, 18-25) falls back to Codex without writing a marker.
  WHY: Heal-route commits written by Codex are authored as claude-bot and logged as engine=claude. Reviewers rated this MAJOR. Confidence ranged 4-5.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:328-329 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The AI_COMMIT_IDENTITY log line prints the resolved engines rather than the engine that wrote the commit.
  WHY: In the fallback case it prints engine=claude with name=codex-bot, contradicting itself. Reviewers rated this NIT, and the line was cited as 328 or 329.
- scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh:191-194 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: New [ai-autofix] commits have empty author and committer logins, so the identity loop cannot match them and exits with ADVANCE=unknown.
  WHY: The stale-base guard is degraded, because scripts/review_autofix_step_merge_topology_gate.sh takes its fail-open branch. The PR documents this as intentional. NIT.
- README.md:333 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The AUTOFIX_BOT_LOGIN row (and, per one reviewer, probably_unnecessary_but_read_if_stuck.md at lines 284 and 337) does not say that pipeline commits now carry empty logins, so the self-triggered skip always fails open.
  WHY: This is documentation drift, and opted-in repositories silently lose the cost saving. NIT.
- agents.d/commit-identity-follows-engine.md:6 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The fragment says "four AI writers", but its table lists five writers and changelog.d/commit-identity-follows-engine.md:9 says five.
  WHY: The documentation contradicts itself. NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The agents fragment says "The four AI writers decide this from what actually ran", while the PR description and changelog (changelog.d/commit-identity-follows-engine.md:9) name five writers.
  expected_change_site: agents.d/commit-identity-follows-engine.md (opening sentence, line 6)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment's prose counts four writers, its own table lists five (the fourth row bundles review_rb_judge.sh and the poller's combined judge), and the changelog counts five.
- requirement: "Every other pipeline commit stays codex-bot", with the engine named for "a model that wrote" the commit.
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11191 and scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:717-726
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: Both still use codex-bot unconditionally. The PR states this limit, so the fragment's opening sentence over-promises rather than the code being wrong.
- requirement: The review-blocked external-head classifier matches on name or email when the commit has no login; the README row for REVIEW_BLOCKED_AUTO_UNSTICK states the accepted identities.
  expected_change_site: README.md:336 (REVIEW_BLOCKED_AUTO_UNSTICK row) and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27753-27765
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The code still accepts codex-bot as a login (case codex|codex-bot|github-actions|github-actions[bot]), but the rewritten README row lists only codex, github-actions and github-actions[bot] as logins.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:277 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: REVIEW_EDITOR_ENGINE_FELL_BACK is written only as true in run_editor_codex_attempt and never reset to false (consumed at scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:339); the attempt loop at review_apply_fixes.sh:2309-2316 calls it once per attempt.
  WHY: A Claude-written commit after an earlier fallback is authored as codex-bot, breaking the PR contract. The other four writers recompute per attempt.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:318-327 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The claude-bot condition tests only the claude-implement*.unavailable markers, and scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh (78-83) falls back to Codex without writing one.
  WHY: Codex-written heal commits are authored as claude-bot and logged engine=claude.
- scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh:191-194 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: New [ai-autofix] commits have empty logins, so the loop cannot match AUTOFIX_BOT_LOGIN and exits with ADVANCE=unknown.
  WHY: A later external [ai-autofix]-prefixed commit is not classified as external, and the merge topology gate fails open. The PR documents this as intentional.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:328 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The AI_COMMIT_IDENTITY log prints resolved engines, not the engine that wrote the commit.
  WHY: It prints engine=claude with name=codex-bot in the fallback case; review_commit_changes.sh:346 avoids this by logging fell_back=.
- README.md (AUTOFIX_BOT_LOGIN row); probably_unnecessary_but_read_if_stuck.md (reported at lines 284 and 337) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: With empty logins on pipeline commits, the opt-in AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED skip always fails open. The README row was updated, but the runbook reportedly still describes the old guard.
  WHY: Documentation drift. Opted-in repositories silently lose the cost saving.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: The agents fragment says "The four AI writers..." while the PR description and changelog name five writers.
  Expected change site: agents.d/commit-identity-follows-engine.md, first sentence after the heading.
  Evidence of absence: The table lists four rows that cover five writers, and the changelog says five. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Every other pipeline commit stays codex-bot", with the engine named for "a model that wrote" the commit.
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11191 and scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:717-726.
  Evidence of absence: Both still use codex-bot unconditionally. Whether a model wrote them was not checked. The PR states this limit. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
- HARDENING: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh (before the Claude attempt, about lines 252-277): write REVIEW_EDITOR_ENGINE_FELL_BACK=false before each Claude attempt (about 2 lines); scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh lines 78-83: create claude-implement.unavailable under the codex-thread-reuse states directory when falling back (about 3 lines); scripts/review_commit_changes.sh lines 338-339: invert the test to a case so that only true selects codex-bot (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:272-277 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: REVIEW_EDITOR_ENGINE_FELL_BACK is only ever written as true and never reset in the retry loop.
  WHY: A fallback in an earlier editor attempt makes all later Claude-written commits in the job authored as codex-bot.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:318-327 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The claude-bot condition depends only on the marker files, and the heal route in scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh falls back to Codex without writing them.
  WHY: Codex-edited heal commits are authored as claude-bot and logged as engine=claude.
- README.md:333 (AUTOFIX_BOT_LOGIN) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The row still says pipeline commits are authored as codex-bot / claude-bot on the .invalid domain, without clarifying that this identity applies only to commits that do not link to a GitHub account.
  WHY: Documentation drift that may confuse operators about the self-triggered skip behaviour.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The four AI writers decide this from what actually ran" (agents.d fragment, line 5)
  Expected change site: agents.d/commit-identity-follows-engine.md
  Evidence of absence: The fragment says four, but its table lists five writers (the fourth row holds review_rb_judge.sh and the poller's combined judge). | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- HARDENING: reset REVIEW_EDITOR_ENGINE_FELL_BACK to false at the start of every editor attempt in run_editor_codex_attempt (1 line); have scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh write the fallback marker when the editor falls back to Codex (3-5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:274-277 (write), scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:338-345 (read); retry loop scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:2102-2886; second invocation scripts/review_autofix_step_apply_fixes_editor.sh:78 and :160 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: REVIEW_EDITOR_ENGINE_FELL_BACK is a one-way latch written only as true and persisted via GITHUB_ENV, across later attempts and across both editor invocations.
  WHY: Attempt 1 falls back, attempt 2 succeeds on Claude, and the commit step still authors it as codex-bot. This is the misattribution the PR exists to remove.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:317-327 (heal editor scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:18-25, 64-99, 100-109; .github/workflows/implement.yml:3641-3642; marker writer scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:742-759) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The claude-bot decision relies on markers written only by codex_thread_reuse.sh, and the heal route falls back to Codex (exit 75 and support_missing) without writing any marker.
  WHY: Both roles still resolve to claude, so a Codex-written heal commit is authored as claude-bot and logged engine=claude repair_engine=claude.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:328 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The AI_COMMIT_IDENTITY line logs resolved engines, not the engine that wrote the commit.
  WHY: In the fallback it prints engine=claude repair_engine=claude name=codex-bot, which is self-contradictory. The line is a registered stable log prefix.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: PR description lists 5 writers, and changelog.d/commit-identity-follows-engine.md:9 says the same.
  Expected change site: agents.d/commit-identity-follows-engine.md:6
  Evidence of absence: The fragment says "four AI writers", but the table at lines 9-14 lists five. | severity=NIT | confidence=5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The review-blocked external-head classifier matches on name or email when the commit has no login"; the README row for REVIEW_BLOCKED_AUTO_UNSTICK states the accepted identities.
  Expected change site: README.md:336 and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27753-27765
  Evidence of absence: The code still accepts codex-bot as a login, but the rewritten README row lists only codex, github-actions and github-actions[bot] as logins. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
